New Koala Duo Alert!🐨

Say hello to Myalla, 6-year-old female, and Chuckels, 10-year-old male, the newest arrivals at the Louisville Zoo!

Chuckels is named in honor of Chuck Bieler, who pioneered the koala program in the United States. Myalla's name means “Big Talk”.

These two have joined the Louisville Zoo from the West Coast with a breeding recommendation.

You can find Myalla and Chuckels in the Australia Zone near Lorikeet Landing. The best chance to see them awake is in the early morning or late in the afternoon.

Thank you to the logistics experts at @UPS for making #OperationBoomerang possible!
